headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 24, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Chris Sale earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. Dominic Smith led the Padres' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs. In other action, the Minnesota Twins took down the Cleveland Guardians 3-1, with Patrick Bailey hitting a home run and driving in a run, while the Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Tampa Bay Rays 3-1, with Shane Bieber earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Brad Keller has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow UCL tear, while Rafael Marchán has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left knee patellar tendinitis. Addison Barger has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation, and Patrick Corbin has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a left teres major strain.

The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio in a trade with the San Diego Padres for future considerations. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin, while the Colorado Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded RHP Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for RHP Aiden Moffett.

top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 3-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Patrick Bailey leading the Twins' offense. Bailey hit a home run and drove in a run in the game.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Take Down Cardinals 10-6**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a 10-6 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Tyler Locklear leading the team at the plate. Locklear finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Phillies' Brad Keller Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Brad Keller has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow UCL tear. The injury will keep him sidelined for an extended period.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Marinaccio in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio in a trade with the San Diego Padres. The deal was made for future considerations.
